messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx + p95 latency in eu-west and ap-southeast across economy lane. spike started ~2951234400. Impact: ~12% of requests seeing >1s tail and some 503s.
ashley_oncall: oncall here, paging in. looking at global routing dashboard now. disabling non-essential background jobs to free capacity.
maria_eng: I see traffic shift to economy lane from burst queues, plus kv-cache miss rate up in eu-west. probable cache invalidation during last rollout.
ajay_sre: @maria_eng tagging but I'm away today, cc @raj_sre.
raj_sre: jumping in. confirming increased queue length on economy workers in eu-west-2 and ap-sg-1. throughput healthy in priority lane.
ops_lead: suggestion: temporarily increase per-customer rate limit for priority tier, throttle economy lane at edge to preserve p95 for priority.
ashley_oncall: agreed. executing mitigation: 1) enable regional pin for priority -> us-east-1/dedicated clusters 2) apply soft-throttle to economy (50% of normal) in EU/AP 3) roll back recent small config that touched cache keys.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback/kv-config-fix @2951234472 by maria_eng
maria_eng: rollback completed, cache priming job queued (low priority).
ashley_oncall: applying edge throttle now:
```
# curl to update edge policy
curl -X POST https://controlplane.api/traffic/edge-policies \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RB_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west","lane":"economy","rate_pct":50}'
```
ops_lead: set quota bump for priority customers: +25% for next 30m to absorb reroutes.
cs_escalations: notifying top impacted customers in EU (~3) with ETA 30m, advising routing pin.
raj_sre: monitoring: p95 in eu-west dropped from 1.2s -> 420ms after throttle. 5xx rate down 70%. ap-sg improvement lagging ~3m behind.
maria_eng: cache priming showing initial hit-rate recovery, still missing a few hot keys from rollout. I'll circulate a short script to pre-warm the hot keys.
ashley_oncall: pre-warm script executed on eu-west seeds.
ops_lead: we should keep economy throttle active until cache hit-rate > 90% and p95 stable for 3 consecutive 5-min windows.
raj_sre: agreed. alerting thresholds adjusted: p95>600ms in any region -> page SRE.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: rollback/kv-config-fix succeeded.
cs_escalations: update sent to customers, marking incident as mitigated for front-end impact.
ashley_oncall: status update: mitigation holding, keeping page open for 60m observation. will escalate to SEV if regress. thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops_lead: follow-ups: postmortem owner @maria_eng, include hot-key rollout checklist and automated pre-warm in deploy pipeline.
maria_eng: ack, will draft and share.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: actions taken: economy regional throttle (eu/ap), priority pin to dedicated clusters, kv-config rollback, cache pre-warm. Current status: mitigated -> monitoring.
